endorsements.quote: Operationalize AI within PV workflows by training models on structured ICSRs and unstructured clinical text, set calibrated alert thresholds, and routing signals to adju dication teams for clinical causality assessment.
Institute periodic external validation against gold-standard datasets, bias and drift monitoring, and auditable model cards for transparency.

unlisted_practices: Embed fit-for-purpose cardiac safety endpoints from first-in-human oncology trials onward, aligned to mechanism of action and anticipated cardiovascular risk.
Mandate interoperable, continuous safety data pipelines connecting pre-market clinical databases with post-market EHRs, registries, claims, and device feeds using FHIR and OMOP standards.
Establish a cross-functional data governance board overseeing data quality controls, quarterly audits, and provenance tracking for safety data pipelines.

Require sponsors to preregister transparent real-world evidence protocols for accelerated approvals, and have an independent oversight committee monitor real-time cardiovascular outcome dashboards with interim decision rules.
Pre-specify label-update triggers tied to cardiac signal thresholds.

screen.reason: This is a framework/perspective/review article that outlines collaborative oversight models, policy, and strategic frameworks for continuous surveillance and AI-enabled cardiotoxicity detection rather than presenting an empirical study.
